svg.aria-label: Work manifest. Six selected projects. technical-doc-generator, Python. Point it at a codebase and get back a README, an API reference, a UML diagram, and inline comments. Runs fully offline on a local model. ai-code-reviewer, TypeScript. Scores code across ten quality dimensions and exports a PDF report. No cloud API keys required, so nothing you review is uploaded. Token_minimiser, JavaScript. Chrome extension that shrinks prompts before they reach ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. Same instructions, 15-45% fewer tokens, works in any text box. FunellQ, TypeScript. Funnel analytics on Google's public GA4 e-commerce dataset. Finds where shoppers drop off, then sizes the biggest leak in real revenue. Siglo-GTM-tool, Python. GTM intelligence platform that scores signals, member targets, and open opportunities into a ranked list of business development plays. EduBot, TypeScript. Study assistant for engineering students in their own language, with quizzes, flashcards, and interview prep. Upstream. AOBench is a role-aware, permission-enforced benchmark for AI agents that operate HPC systems. I work on its command line interface. Pull requests authored: 43, add --json to report json and compare runs; 47, add aobench list coverage; 50, pay down mypy --strict debt in cli/. Contributions in the last 12 months as of 2026-08-30: 284 contributions across 130 active days, longest streak 8 days, busiest day 21 contributions.
